messages:
deploy-bot: Manual approval required for PROD deploy -> service: inference-runtime, env: production, tag: v3.2.1-rc4, commit: 3f9a1b2. Requested by @product-luca. Auto-safety scan flagged quant profile change. Change window: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary plan: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Quant profile: q4_0 (pinned requested). Notes: baseline p50 ~72ms.

ops_jia: quick q's: what's the explicit rollback command, and expected user impact? also we saw ~+3% latency on long sequences w/ q4_0 last time.

devops-ernie: Rollback micro-plan: 1) route traffic back to tag v3.2.0 (commit 8b2f4c0). 2) scale v3.2.0 to pre-deploy replica count. 3) drain v3.2.1 nodes. Commands: ```./infractl route set --service inference-runtime --tag v3.2.0 && ./deploy scale --service inference-runtime --tag v3.2.0 --replicas 8 && ./deploy drain --service inference-runtime --tag v3.2.1``` Expected impact: near-zero session loss, config apply within ~30s. If urgent rollback, run: `./deploy rollback --service inference-runtime --to-tag v3.2.0 --force`

paul-sre: add runbook checks: watch p95 token latency and model-mismatch rate. Alert triggers: error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 300ms -> immediate rollback. Also watch token-generation stalls (KV cache misses).

product-luca: business signoff: I approve. Confirm feature-flag fallback exists to disable new model if perf issues. Also confirm quant profile pinned to q4_0 for this rollout.

kate: +1 from SE: Verified canary tests and smoke dataset. APPROVED. :thumbsup: @paul-sre @ops_jia

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: product-luca, kate. Manual prod gate cleared. Starting canary: 10% traffic now. Deploy CID: deploy-1891012345-1. Doc: https://console.redwood.ai/deployments/1891012345

ci-bot: Smoke tests started (canary). Tests: inference_smoke, perf_smoke, auth_check. Running...

ci-bot: Smoke tests: PASSED. p50=80ms, p95=180ms, errors=0.03%.

deploy-bot: Canary 10% healthy after 16m. Proceeding to 50% for 30m. Rollback window open until 1891012568. Monitoring dashboards: https://obs.redwood.ai/d/inference-runtime/1891012345
